name: deposit-insurance-coverage-check
title: Deposit Insurance Coverage Check
description: Three-stage check over a bank's own deposit insurance numbers. Step 1 computes insured and uninsured minor-unit amounts per ownership right and capacity group against the caller-supplied SMDIA, reporting records that cannot be calculated as undeterminable and naming the missing field (ART-507). Step 2 validates the shape of the institution's own part 370 output file and ties its declared totals to the step 1 recompute, reporting a shape defect and a totals mismatch as separate findings (ART-535). Step 3 produces a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). The output file is the caller's own; the coverage limit is a caller-supplied input and is never assumed. The verdict is an arithmetic and shape finding, never a determination by the FDIC, not a filing, and no deposit insurance advice.

steps.handoff: Computes insured and uninsured minor-unit amounts per ownership right and capacity group against the caller-supplied SMDIA, with records that cannot be calculated reported undeterminable naming the missing field; that recompute is what step 2 ties against. Stage 1 of 3.

Validates the shape of the institution's own part 370 output file and ties its declared totals to the step 1 recompute, reporting file structure errors and totals mismatches as separate findings with a gate policy verdict; the validated run's execution hashes are what step 3 aggregates. Stage 2 of 3.
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage).
